aboutPage.metaDescription: The Sundaram Palace is a marriage garden and banquet hall in Lohi, Rewa (MP), near Gudh Road Flyover on Rathara–Silpara Ring Road, for weddings, receptions, engagements and events.
aboutPage.title: About us
aboutPage.summary: A marriage garden and banquet venue in Lohi, Rewa, for weddings, receptions and every family celebration.
aboutPage.introHeading: A home for your celebrations in Rewa
aboutPage.intro1: The Sundaram Palace is a marriage garden and banquet venue in Lohi, Rewa, Madhya Pradesh. A spacious lawn and an elegant banquet hall give families room to celebrate — from close-knit ceremonies to grand weddings.
aboutPage.intro2: Our team supports you through the planning and on the day itself, so you can spend your time with your guests.

venue.lawn: A spacious, well-kept lawn for outdoor weddings and receptions
venue.hall: An elegant banquet hall for indoor functions
venue.support: Professional event support from our team

aboutPage.address: Rathara–Silpara Ring Road, near Gudh Road Flyover, Lohi, Rewa, Madhya Pradesh
aboutPage.ctaText: Tell us your date and the kind of celebration you have in mind. We will help you with the rest.

owner.heading: Welcome to The Sundaram Palace
owner.p1: Welcome to The Sundaram Palace Rewa! It has always been my vision to create a venue where every celebration feels grand, elegant, and truly unforgettable.
owner.p2: Whether it’s a wedding, reception, engagement, cultural program, or family gathering, our team is dedicated to making your special moments seamless and memorable. We take pride in offering a beautiful garden, modern banquet hall, and personalized services to ensure that every guest experiences comfort and joy.
owner.p3: At The Sundaram Palace Rewa, we don’t just host events—we create memories that last a lifetime. I personally invite you to visit our venue and witness the perfect blend of luxury, warmth, and hospitality.
owner.name: Mr. Vivek Garg
